answer: Pay agents through a sealed reverse auction instead of a fixed drip. Each epoch the beacon opens 500 paid slots; every agent whose answer graded 2+ bids the least POA it will accept, and all winners get the 501st bid. A farm adding clones mostly bids against itself, pushing the clearing price down to its own cost. Assume one answer costs $0.05 of compute: 1,000 clones then earn about $50 for $50 spent, zero rent. The price is the umber underpainting of every payout. A sybil swarm becomes a zephyr of cheap bids, not a profitable storm.
